# omni_dbt_configuration (Resource)

Attaches a dbt project to a connection. There is at most one of these per connection: the API exposes a single `PUT`, with no separate create, so applying this resource to a connection that already has dbt configured replaces that configuration rather than failing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "omni_dbt_configuration" "warehouse" {
  connection_id = omni_connection.warehouse.id

  ssh_url = "git@github.com:acme/dbt-analytics.git"
  branch  = "main"

  auth_method = "ssh"

  # Required for dbt environments to route queries to a different schema.
  enable_virtual_schemas = true

  # Generate Omni relationships from the relationships dbt already declares,
  # rather than redefining them in the semantic model.
  autogen_relationships = true

  committer_name  = "Omni"
  committer_email = "data-platform@acme.example"
}

# With auth_method = "ssh", Omni generates the deploy key. It has to be added to
# the repository before the first schema refresh, or Omni cannot clone it.
output "omni_deploy_key" {
  value       = omni_dbt_configuration.warehouse.public_key
  description = "Add to the dbt repository as a deploy key."
}

resource "omni_dbt_configuration" "monorepo" {
  connection_id = omni_connection.staging.id

  ssh_url = "https://github.com/acme/platform.git"
  branch  = "main"

  auth_method = "https_token"
  token       = var.dbt_repository_token

  # dbt_project.yml is not at the repository root.
  project_root_path = "warehouse/dbt"

  dbt_version = "1.11"
}

variable "dbt_repository_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true

  # The API never returns this, so Terraform cannot detect drift on it.
  description = "Deploy token for the dbt repository."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `branch` (String) Branch Omni reads the dbt project from.
- `connection_id` (String) The connection the dbt project is attached to.
- `ssh_url` (String) Git URL of the dbt project. Despite the name the API uses, this carries an HTTPS URL when `auth_method` is `https_token`.

### Optional

- `auth_method` (String) How Omni authenticates to the repository: `ssh`, `https_token` or `github_app`. `https_token` requires `token`, and `github_app` requires `github_app_installation_id`.
- `autogen_relationships` (Boolean) Generate Omni relationships from the dbt project's declared relationships.
- `committer_email` (String) Email Omni commits as when it writes back to the repository.
- `committer_name` (String) Name Omni commits as when it writes back to the repository.
- `dbt_version` (String) dbt version Omni parses the project with. `Auto` tracks the version declared in the project.
- `enable_semantic_layer` (Boolean) Import the dbt semantic layer alongside the models.
- `enable_virtual_schemas` (Boolean) Allow dbt environments to route queries to a different target schema.
- `github_app_installation_id` (String) Numeric GitHub App installation ID, required when `auth_method` is `github_app`.
- `project_root_path` (String) Path to the dbt project within the repository, for a monorepo. Leave unset when `dbt_project.yml` is at the repository root.
- `rotate_keys` (Boolean) Set to `true` to have Omni generate a new SSH key pair on the next apply. Only meaningful for `ssh`. This is an instruction rather than a setting: the API does not return it, so Terraform cannot tell whether a rotation has happened, and leaving it `true` rotates on every apply.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Deploy token or personal access token, required when `auth_method` is `https_token`. Never returned by the API, so drift on this value is not detected.

### Read-Only

- `commit_signing_public_key` (String) Public key Omni signs its commits with, returned when `auth_method` is `ssh`.
- `id` (String) Same as `connection_id`. The configuration has no identifier of its own because it is a property of the connection.
- `public_key` (String) Deploy key to add to the repository, returned when `auth_method` is `ssh`. Add this to the repository before the first schema refresh, or Omni cannot clone it.
- `supports_dbt` (Boolean) Whether the connection's dialect supports dbt at all.
